Database.Password: <set with: dotnet user-secrets set Database:Password ...  or env var WCS_DB_PASSWORD - never commit>

DataProtection.KeysPath: <optional folder that stores the key ring used to encrypt PLC/RCS passwords and tokens; back it up, keep it outside the repository>

Admin.Username: <first administrator login; only used while NO active administrator exists>
Admin.Password: <set with: dotnet user-secrets set Bootstrap:Admin:Password ...  or env var Bootstrap__Admin__Password - never commit; must be changed at first sign-in>
